risk_description: Eastern Highlands over-represented because it is closest to research institutions and easiest to reach.
mitigation: Explicit quotas enforced in the collection protocol: 200 Eastern Highlands, 150 Mazowe, 150 Zvishavane.
measurement_method: Sample counts by ecozone against quota, computed per batch.
monitoring_query: SELECT ecozone, COUNT(*) FROM environmental_samples GROUP BY ecozone

risk_description: Microbial and plant secondary-metabolite chemistry differs between wet and dry season; a single-season dataset confounds season with site.
mitigation: Dry-season collection Sep-Nov 2026 and wet-season refresh Jan-Mar 2027. Season tag mandatory on every record.
measurement_method: Record counts by season within each ecozone.
monitoring_query: SELECT ecozone, season, COUNT(*) FROM environmental_samples GROUP BY ecozone, season

risk_description: Shona-dominant collection under-represents Ndebele-speaking knowledge communities.
mitigation: Dedicated Ndebele-speaking field officer. Minimum 30% of heritage records from Ndebele-speaking communities. Language tag mandatory. Corpus-trained tokenizer rather than an English tokenizer, so neither language is fragmented at the modelling stage.
measurement_method: Share of active heritage records with language_tag = 'nd', checked per batch by the validator.
monitoring_query: SELECT language_tag, COUNT(*) FROM heritage_knowledge WHERE record_status='active' GROUP BY language_tag

risk_description: LC-MS profiles vary with instrument calibration and extraction protocol; sequencing error profiles differ between Nanopore and Illumina.
mitigation: Standardised extraction protocol documented. Calibration log per batch in the QC log. Duplicate extraction on 10% of samples. Platform and basecalling model recorded on every sequence record so batch effects can be modelled rather than ignored.
measurement_method: Duplicate-extraction agreement rate; distribution of records by platform.
monitoring_query: SELECT platform, COUNT(*) FROM genomic_sequences GROUP BY platform

risk_description: Older knowledge holders are less available during peak farming season, skewing the corpus toward those with time to participate.
mitigation: Collection scheduled outside peak farming windows. Community councils assist with advance scheduling. Interviewer identity recorded so interviewer-specific effects are detectable.
measurement_method: Interview counts by month and by interviewer.
monitoring_query: SELECT interviewer_id, COUNT(*) FROM heritage_knowledge GROUP BY interviewer_id

risk_description: Protected-area access uncertainty pushes collection onto communal land, over-representing human-modified habitat.
mitigation: Land tenure recorded on every sample. Any analysis of undisturbed-habitat chemistry must disclose that the sample is communal-land weighted. Protected-area access remains a Phase I gate rather than being quietly dropped.
monitoring_query: SELECT land_tenure, COUNT(*) FROM environmental_samples GROUP BY land_tenure

mitigation: Field protocol requires a minimum of 20 km from urban centres for all sample sites.
measurement_method: Distance-to-urban-centre computed per site during route planning.

risk_description: Most untargeted LC-MS features are never confidently identified, so the annotated subset over-represents compounds already in Western spectral libraries — the exact bias this dataset exists to correct.
mitigation: MSI level recorded on every feature. Levels 3-4 reported as hypotheses, never as identifications. Unannotated features retained rather than discarded, because they are the novel fraction.
measurement_method: Distribution of msi_annotation_level across all features.
monitoring_query: SELECT msi_annotation_level, COUNT(*) FROM metabolomic_profiles GROUP BY msi_annotation_level
